fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Foot infantry Level I formations anchor defensive positions and garrison critical installations, providing the persistent ground presence that BattleMech and armor units cannot maintain indefinitely. Com Guard foot infantry train alongside heavier elements and understand their role within the larger combined-arms framework. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
